verses.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
verses.sm: O LE tolu o tausaga o Hosea M8 atalii o Ele le tupu o Isaraelu na fai ai ma tupu Esekia le atalii o Aasa le tupu o luta.

verses.en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
verses.sm: O le luafulu ma le lima o ona tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu; o tausaga e luafulu ma le iva na tupu ai o ia i Ierusalema. O le igoa foi o lona tinā o Avi o le afafine o Sakaria.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia le amiotonu i luma o Ieova, faapei o mea uma na faia e Tavita lona tamā.

verses.en: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verses.sm: Ua ia aveeseina mea maualuluga, ua ia tuipalaina foi tupua, ua na vavae i lalo foi tupua o Asaira, ua na tuʻininiia foi le gata sapa memea na faia e Mose ; auā e oo lava i ona po ia na faamu i ai mea manogi e le fanauga a Isaraelu, na na ta‘ua ai foi, o le fasi ‘apa memea.

verses.en: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
verses.sm: Ua ia faatuatua ia Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu; ua leai foi se la te tutusa ma ia i tupu uma o Iuta na mulimuli ia te ia, atoa foi ma e na muamua ia te ia.

verses.en: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua ia pipii lava ia Ieova, ua le tuua lava lona mulimuli atu ia te ia, a ua tausi lava ana poloaiga na poloai mai ai Ieova ia Mose.

verses.en: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
verses.sm: Sa ia te ia Ieova, na manuia ai foi o ia i mea uma na ia alu i ai; ua foua foi e ia le tupu o Asuria, ma ua le auauna ia te ia.

verses.en: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.sm: Ua ia fasia Filisitia e oo lava i Kasa ma ona nuu; o le pae o tagata leoleo atoa ma le aai nofo ‘olo.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
verses.sm: O le fa o tausaga o le tupu o Esekia, o le fitu foi lea o tausaga o Hosea le atalii o Ele le tupu o Isaraelu, na alu ae ai o Salemanesa le tupu o Asuria i Samaria, ua ia vagaia.

verses.en: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.sm: Ua mavae foi tausaga e tolu ona aea ai lea; o le tausaga e ono o Esekia, o le tausaga e iva foi lea o Hosea le tupu o Isaraelu, na aea ai Samaria.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
verses.sm: Ona faatāfeaina lea o Isaraelu i Asuria e le tupu o Asuria, ua na tuu atu ia te i latou i Hala ma Havoli e lata ane i le vaitafe o Kosane, atoa ma aai o Metai.

verses.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
verses.sm: Auā na Iatou le faalogo i le siufofoga o Ieova lo latou Atua, a ua soli lana feagaiga, atoa ma mea uma na poloai mai ai Mose Ie auauna a Ieova, ua latou le faalogo i ai, ma ua le faia.

verses.en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.sm: O le sefulu ma le fa o tausaga o le tupu o Esekia na sii ai le taua e Sanerivi le tupu o Asuria i aai nofo ‘olo uma o Iuta, ma na aea ai.

verses.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.sm: Ona tuu atu ai lea e Esekia le tupu o luta o le sāvali i le tupu o Asuria i Lakisa, ua faapea atu, Ua ou sese ; ia e toe afio ese ia te au; a o le mea e te totogi mai ai ia te au, ou te faia lea. Ona totogi mai ai lea e le tupu o Asuria ia Esekia le tupu o Iuta o taleni ario e tolu selau, ma taleni auro e tolugafulu.

verses.en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.
verses.sm: Ona avatu ai lea e Esekia o ario uma na i ai i le fale o Ieova, ma mea e teu ai oloa i le fale o le tupu.

verses.en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.sm: O ona po ia na fofoe ese ai e Esekia o auro sa i puipui o le malumalu o Ieova, atoa ma pou na ufiufi i le auro e Esekia le tupu o Iuta, ua na avatu ai le tupu Asuria.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.sm: Ua aauina mai foi e le tupu o Asuria o Taretana, ma Kavesarisa, ma Ravesaki, ma ‘au e tele mai Lakisa i le tupu o Esekia i Ierusalema. Ona latou o ae ai lea, ua oo i Ierusalema. Ua o ae i latou, ona o mai ai lea, ua tutū latalata ane i le alavai o le vailepa aupitoaluga, o i le ala tele o le fanua o le ta ofu.

verses.en: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.sm: Ua latou valaau mai i le tupu, ona o atu ai lea ia te i latou o Eliakimo le atalii o Hilikia o le na pule i le aiga, ma Sevena le tusiupu, ma Ioaa le atalii o Asafo le fātuaiupu.

verses.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Ravesaki ia te i latou, Ia outou fai atu ia Esekia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu silisili, o le tupu o Asuria, Pe se a lea faatuatuaga ua e faatuatua i ai ?

verses.en: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.sm: Ua e faapea ane (a o upu faatauvaa lava) ua ia te oe le poto ma le malosi e fai a‘i taua. O lenei, pe e te faatuatua ia te ai, ua e foua ai a‘u ?

verses.en: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
verses.sm: Faauta nei, ua e tōonai i lea tootoo u ua gapepe o Aikupito, pe a totoo i ai se tagata e tuia ai lona lima e ati; e faapea lava Farao le tupu o Aikupito ia te i latou uma o e faatuatua ia te ia.

verses.en: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
verses.sm: A e afai tou te faapea mai ia te au, Matou te faatuatua ia ieova lo matou Atua; e le o ia ea ua aveeseina ai e Esekia o ana mea maualuluga, ma ona fata faitaulaga, ma ua fai atu ia Iuta ma Ierusalema, Ia outou tapuai i luma o lenei fata faitaulaga o i Ierusalema?

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.sm: O lenei ina au mai ia ni mea e tuu faafaatau i lo‘u alii le tupu o Asuria, ona ou avatu ai lea ia te oe o solofanua e lua afe, pe afai e te mafaia e oe ona ia tofu ma se tietie ai.

verses.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.sm: A e mafai faapefea ona e tulia se tasi ta‘ita‘i o auauna e aupito ona faatauvaa a lo‘u alii, a e faatuatua i Aikupito e maua ai kariota ma ‘au e tietie i solofanua ?

verses.en: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.sm: Fā‘i ea ua ou sau nei e aunoa ma Ieova i lenei mea e faaumatia ai ? Na fetalai mai Ieova ia te au, ou te alu ae i lenei nuu ia faaumatia.

verses.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o Eliakimo le atalii o Hilikia, ma Sevena, ma Ioaa, ia Ravesaki, Ia e fetalai mai i au auauna i le gagana a Arama, auā matou te lagona ai; a e aua e te fetalai mai ia te i matou i le gagana a luta ma le faalogo mai o tagata o i luga o le pa.

verses.en: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Ravesaki ia te i latou, Ua auina mai ea a‘u e lo4u alii i lou alii atoa ma oe e tautala atu ai i ia upu, a e lei auina ea i tagata o e nonofo i luga o le pa, ina ia latou topalega, ma feinu i o latou lava miaga faatasi ma outou ?

verses.en: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.sm: Ona tu mai ai lea o Ravesaki, ua alaga ua leo tele i le gagana a Iuta, ua faapea mai lana upu, Faalogologo mai ia i le afioga a le tupu silisili, o le tupu o Asuria;

verses.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
verses.sm: o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu, Aua ne‘i olegia outou e Esekia, auā na te le mafaia ona laveai ia te outou ai lona lima.

verses.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.sm: Aua nefi faatupuina foi e Esekia so outou faatuatua ia Ieova, o loo faapea ane o ia, E laveai mai lava Ieova ia te i tatou, e le tuuina atu foi lenei aai i le lima o le tupu o Asuria.

verses.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
verses.sm: Aua ne‘i outou faalogo ia Esekia ; auā o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu o Asuria, Ina au mai ia te au se mea alofa, ma ia o mai ia te au, ona outou aai ai lea taitasi i lona lava vine, e taitasi foi i lona lava mati, ma outou feinu foi taitasi i le vai o lona lava vaieli,

verses.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.
verses.sm: seia ou alu atu e ave ia te outou i le nuu faapei o lo outou lava nuu, o le nuu o i ai saito ma uaina, o le nuu o i ai areto ma tovine, o le nuu o i ai le suāuu olive ma le meli; ina ia ola outou, a e le oti; aua foi tou te faalogo ia Esekia i lona faa‘ole‘ole ia te outou, o loo faapea ane, E laveai mai Ieova ia te i tatou.

verses.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.sm: Pe ai se atua o i se nuu ua na laveai i lona nuu ai le lima o le tupu o Asuria?

verses.en: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
verses.sm: Po o ifea atua o Amato ma Arepa ? Po o ifea atua o Sefavaima, o Ena ma Iva ? Po ua latou laveai ea i Samaria ai lo‘u lima?

verses.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
verses.sm: Po o ai ni atua uma o nuu ua laveai i o latou nuu ai lo‘u lima, ina ia laveai e Ieova i Ierusalema ai lo‘u lima?

verses.en: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.sm: A ua faalologo le nuu, ua latou le tali atu se upu ia te ia, auā sa faapea mai le poloaiga a le tupu, Aua ne‘i tali atu ia te ia.

verses.en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o Eliakimo le atalii o Hilikia le pule i le aiga, ma Sevena le tusiupu, ma Ioaa le atalii o Asafo le fātuaiupu, ia Esekia, ma o latou ofu ua saei, ua latou tala mai ia te ia o upu a Ravesaki. 0 le feau a Fsekia ia Isaia; o le
